Enemy had 1 healer; only 1 of us carried anti-heal — usually wants two vs a heal comp.

coaching.headline: The objective ledger read 3 takes to their 23 — nobody played the map, and it was over in 21 minutes.
coaching.team: Three lanes read favored and the film flags the same failure on repeat: at 6.5, 10.6, 12.6, 15 and 20.4 a winning lane stayed home while a short-handed fight was lost across the map. Meanwhile our whole team put just 1482 damage into objectives against their 44492, and their fight wins cashed three times. The film flags two of us with no armor into Crunch's 24k physical, and per the file nearly every death priced a Mini Prime, a tower or a Fangtooth.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 8.2-to-10.6 stretch decided it — a run of deaths the file prices at Mini Prime and the first outer tower — and the map never came back: majors 3-23.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's carry lane was read favored and finished 1/6 — Eden killed him five times, and the file prices the falls at 10.6, 12.7 and 18.1 at towers and Fangtooth. Two completed items in 21 minutes means the lane's edge never became damage; against a stance carry the plan is poke before her Heat comes online, not trades at her range.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Greystone held the Crunch lane after conceding first blood at 5.2, but the macro flags him four times — 6.5, 10.6, 12.6 and 20.4 — alive and ahead while a two-man fight was lost across the map. A frontliner with a stasis reset is exactly the body those fights were missing.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Ikra traded up inside a losing read — kills on Eden, Khaimera and Gadget by 9.4 — but every one of his three deaths carried a price: the file ties the 8.2 and 9.2 falls to Mini Prime and a tower, and the 18.8 fall to the 19.7 Fangtooth. With mid read 'theirs all game', even trades were trades to skip.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
enemyKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
enemyKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
enemyKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
enemyKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 21 minutes, fewer deaths than about 91% of Crunch offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Re-Crunch at rank 2: 35s base, about 25s by the end (29% shorter) from 40 ability haste: Mutilator 15, Draconum 15, Gaia Greaves 10.
6 takedowns (6 kills, 0 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Crunch dealt 23,868 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +102 physical power from items.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Gaia Greaves (item): Move to generate up to 100 stacks: Stacks grant up to 40 Movement Speed. Basic Attacks expend all stacks for bonus Damage. Deals up to 40 (+60%)(+5%) Damage.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Crush (Eternal minor): Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 8% of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage, with an 8s cooldown per target.
Breach (Eternal minor): Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.
Combo Crunch (augment): Dealing damage with Cross Crunch grants 7.5% Total Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 4 times.

Sustain: 16% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; 8,930 healing recorded.
Toughness: +400 health, +90 physical armor; took 24,157 damage, mitigated 23,517, died 1 times.

(game text: Dealing damage with Cross Crunch grants 7.5% Total Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 4 times.) (changes Cross Crunch) Field: 50.2% in 2606 games, 88% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.9%.

Loadout minor Crush: Locking a hero down deals a chunk of their max health. Forward Crunch's stun and Turbo Right Crunch's knock-up both trigger it. (game text: Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 8% of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage, with an 8s cooldown per target.)

Loadout minor Breach: Your ultimate damage cuts the target's armor briefly. Crunch's ultimate repeats another ability, and our data does not confirm that hit counts as ultimate damage, so treat this as uncertain. (game text: Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.)

Loadout crest Iceskorn Talons: Drop an ice sheet where you dive in: allies on it gain power and speed, enemies on it are slowed. Use it when your team follows you into a fight. (game text: Glacial Colosseum:  Create an Ice Sheet around you for 8s. Allies on the sheet gain 12% Physical Power for 3s. They also gain 12% Movement Speed for 3s. Enemy Units on the sheet are Slowed by 10%.) Field: 53.3% in 807 games, 27% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.9%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Gaia Greaves, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Draconum, Iceskorn Talons.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Crush. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Crush + Breach) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Crunch killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Steel. We killed Crunch 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Crunch offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Re-Crunch came back about every 25s instead of 35s by the end (29% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

stacks.title: Damage that scales with our health

members.name: Mutilator
members.text: On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.

members.name: Crush
members.text: Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 8% of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage, with an 8s cooldown per target.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Crush. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Crush + Breach) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 0 of the 3 players Crunch killed built physical armor.

copy.text: Too few Crunch offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

loadout.name: Focal Lens
loadout.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Tachyon Lance shreds their Physical Armor by 25% for 4s and reduces the cooldown by 10%.
loadout.plain: Landing ranged Q (Tachyon Lance) lowers the target's physical armor and trims its cooldown. Open with the laser so your gun fire and follow-up hit through armor.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Attacks and abilities stack Rust on heroes, lowering both their armors and giving you some. Eden's fast attacks reach full stacks quickly in any trade.

loadout.name: Frequency
loadout.text: Gain 2% Total Attack Speed and 2 Ability Haste per Rust stack currently applied.
loadout.plain: Each Rust stack on a target gives attack speed and ability cooldown speed. On Eden extra attack speed also turns into physical power, so full Rust ramps her damage.

loadout.name: Peal
loadout.text: Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: Faster ultimate cooldown, and casting Limit Break applies full Rust for a short time. Overheat, ult, and every hit after it shreds armor immediately.

loadout.name: Witchstalker
loadout.text: Purifying Strike:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Empower your next Damage Instance within 8s. Deal 4% Target Max Health as Damage. Double the Damage if a Debuff is Cleansed. Heal equal to the Damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Cleanses debuffs and empowers your next hit with damage based on the target's max health, healing you for it. Best into tanks or when cleansing a stun or slow.

lines: Eden dealt 8,823 hero damage, 14% of their team's, with +77 physical power from items.

Penetration: Witchstalker 5; against Murdock (level 12: about 78 physical armor, 73 after penetration; took 7,202 physical damage from heroes, 66% of all hero damage they took) and Greystone (level 13: about 85 physical armor, 80 after penetration; took 10,476 physical damage from heroes, 64% of all hero damage they took) that is about 3% and 3% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
